profile.headline: Senior iOS Engineer | Swift • SwiftUI • Combine • Swift Concurrency | MVVM-C & Clean Architecture | CI/CD • Modular Apps
profile.summary:
Senior iOS Engineer with 12+ years of iOS development experience and 20+ years in software engineering. MSc in Computer Science (University of Liverpool, UK) and BTEC HND in Computing (Edexcel). I specialise in Swift, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, modular architectures (MVVM-C/Clean Architecture), and building secure, scalable, high-performance mobile applications.

I have extensive experience developing large-scale mobile products working with iOS, tvOS and watchOS platforms, delivering AVPlayer-driven media apps, secure internal frameworks, advanced UI systems, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Key achievements:
• Improved app start-up time by 30% through Swift Concurrency migration
• Built modular MVVM-C architecture improving maintainability and speeding onboarding
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane + Bitrise) reducing release cycle by 50%
• Delivered complex AVPlayer video experiences with strong performance and memory optimisation
• Mentored engineers, led architecture reviews, and worked across cross-functional teams

Technical Skills:
Swift • SwiftUI • Swift Concurrency (async/await) • UIKit • Core Data • AVFoundation • AVPlayer • WidgetKit • App Intents • MVVM • MVVM-C • Clean Architecture • Modular Apps • DI • CI/CD (Fastlane, Bitrise) • Keychain • REST • GraphQL • AWS • Docker

I am passionate about system design, performance tuning, concurrency, and delivering exceptional user-centric mobile experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Lead architect and senior engineer for Al Arabiya’s iOS, tvOS and watchOS applications.
- Conduct ongoing research and development on cutting-edge technologies to enhance mobile app capabilities.
- Built advanced UI using UIKit, SwiftUI, Compositional Layouts, and DiffableDataSource.
- Incorporate design tokens to align developers and designers on a shared visual language, enabling consistent UI styling and streamlined updates across the app.
- Designed modular MVVM-C architecture improving scalability and reducing onboarding time.
- Mentored developers and collaborated across product, design and back-end teams.
- Continuously optimize app performance and security through testing, monitoring, and iterative improvements.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Lead the conversion of business requirements into robust system designs, ensuring alignment with both business goals and UI/UX objectives.
- Develop applications using native iOS technologies, adhering to high coding standards and emphasizing modular, maintainable architecture.
- Implement full bilingual (multilingual) support to ensure seamless user experience across different languages.
- Design adaptive user interfaces using Auto Layout for consistent rendering across various device sizes and orientations.
- Integrate and consume RESTful APIs for efficient data communication between client and server layers.
- Perform asynchronous data loading to maintain a responsive UI by keeping the main thread unblocked.
- Utilize Core Data for efficient local data caching, reducing server dependency and optimizing for low-bandwidth scenarios.
- Write unit tests to validate key business logic and functionality, ensuring application reliability and maintainability.
- Conduct in-house testing and distribution through TestFlight to streamline QA and internal feedback loops.
- Manage the App Store approval process, ensuring compliance with Apple’s submission requirements and timely releases.
- Rapidly adapt to evolving business requirements, integrating changes with minimal disruption to the existing workflow.
- Strictly follow Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines to maintain platform consistency and enhance user trust.
- Lead the end-to-end development of applications across iOS, watchOS, and tvOS platforms.
- Utilize Git for source control, ensuring reliable version tracking and collaborative development workflows.
- Continuously engage in research and experimentation with emerging technologies to inform future development strategies.

positions.title: Senior Web / IOS Developer
positions.description:
- Played a key role in the planning, design, development, and testing of the Al Arabiya iOS, tvOS, and watchOS applications by rewriting legacy apps into a unified codebase, with well-defined abstractions to support multilingual and multi-platform customization.
- Refactored legacy apps using clean architecture principles, emphasizing separation of concerns and reusable components to enable code sharing across different platforms and languages.
- Implemented the MVVM architectural pattern to promote modularity, testability, and maintainability.
- Integrated and consumed RESTful APIs for seamless communication between frontend and backend services.
- Integrated third-party SDKs and services, including CocoaPods, Firebase, and Google Tag Manager, to extend app functionality and analytics capabilities.
- Delivered high-quality features in an Agile development environment, effectively handling shifting priorities and evolving requirements.
- Continuously tested and optimized the apps with a focus on security, performance, and overall efficiency.
- Worked closely with the backend team to ensure smooth integration of APIs and reliable data handling.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented a scalable Pageviews tracking system using Docker containers, MongoDB, Flask, and Redis.
- Collaborated with the server-side team to integrate and optimize backend services.
- Developed customized applications based on specific business requirements and urgent client demands.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and tested the system and database for an interactive end-of-day/intraday charting platform (www.btflive.net).
- Led the system and database design, development, testing, and ongoing maintenance of a custom advertisement management system.
- Implemented financial formulas and algorithms to enable advanced market scanning and analytics.
- Performed financial data adjustments, including identifying stock splits and calculating adjustment ratios to normalize historical data.
- Designed and developed a next-generation market prediction engine branded as “Tomorrow’s Market Today,” leveraging historical trends and real-time analysis.

positions.title: Development Lead / Office Manager
positions.description:
- Led the system and database design, development, testing, and maintenance of the full front-end and back-end architecture for a dynamic website generation platform (www.ekwa.com).
- Managed a team of 15 employees, overseeing daily operations, task allocation, and development workflows.
- Designed and developed a customizable standalone web template system tailored for the EKWA platform.
- Created modular, reusable web components for EKWA, including blog systems, photo galleries, article listings, and forums.
- Implemented SEO strategies to enhance platform visibility and search engine performance.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
- Led the system and database design, development, testing, and maintenance of an XML-based web authoring tool for ICSA UK, enabling automated generation of course materials and textbooks from structured XML feeds.
- Oversaw installation, customization, and ongoing maintenance of Mambo-based CMS platforms for various clients.
- Developed a customized online questionnaire system for the Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators, commissioned by a UK government entity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, tested, and maintained a live support system, ensuring real-time communication and user engagement.
- Led the system and database design, development, and testing of a news engine and portfolio management system for a client (www.aureos.com).
- Designed and implemented a vehicle cataloguing system for www.wheelslanka.com, deploying two versions: one for the client’s intranet (VB 6.0) and another for online use.
- Developed a fully automated system for a commercial washing plant using Visual Basic 6.0, covering operational workflows and process control.

- Swift

- JSON API

- Social sharing
- Live streaming
